up: List all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728193. For each molecule, provide the molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728193';
